root.subject: [DISCUSS] KIP-1368: Client framework name and version
root.body:
Hi,
I'd like to open discussion on KIP-1368: Client framework name and version.

Applications often use application frameworks such as Spring to connect to Kafka. To assist with problem diagnosis, this KIP introduces a way to provide the framework name and version as part of the metadata the client
